text:
rachel: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem  I created a concise tracker with the top remediation items: https://tiny.redwood/authz-handoff. Please confirm owners and add blockers.

omar: Ill take the token validation schema update and alerting (row 2). ETA next Tue. Will add example failed-token payloads to the ticket.

ben: I can own secrets rotation automation (row 4)  plan is KMS rotation + CI token purge. ETA 10 business days, will open PM ticket.

ivy: Ill handle permission pruning and role-to-service mapping. Will post a draft PR with proposed removals by EOW.

security-bot: Created tasks: PM-5237 (token-validation), PM-5238 (secrets-rotation), PM-5239 (role-prune). Links in tracker.

rachel: Two asks: (1) add compliance tags (GDPR/CCPA) & retention justification to each PM before marking done; (2) flag legacy CI/service accounts as "migration_required" so we can sequence rotations.

omar: Added sample log filter to PM-5237: `event=token_validation result=fail | stats count by service`  will propose spike thresholds in the ticket.

ben: PR branch started: git.redwood/pr/1477 (rotation scripts). Will attach runbook steps and rollback plan in PM-5238.

ivy: Added a "legacy_flag" column in the tracker and marked 5 entries. Will include migration notes in the PR.

security-bot: Note: PM-5238 linked to CVE-tracking for key rotation windows.

rachel: Scheduling a 30m sync Thu 10:00 PT to walk blockers; invite sent. If a change risks customer auth, owners add `blocking` label and ping #eng-oncall per runbook.

ops-bot: Weekly checkpoint created for PM-5237/PM-5238 every Wed 09:00 PT.

omar: Ack, will scope alerts and add index on audit logs.

ben: Ack, will coordinate maintenance window for KMS version rollout and ensure dual-key acceptance window.

ivy: Ack, will post role-prune plan and tag impacted services.

rachel: Thanks all. Update the tracker as you make progress and drop PRs/docs in the PM comments. See you Thu. :thumbsup:
